tools.name: remind_add
tools.title: Set a reminder
tools.description: A quick reminder: the message as a banner at the top of this desktop's screen, with a sound, in so many minutes (up to a week), at a time of day, or on an event, as the launcher's Tools › Remind sets one: when the computer next wakes (wake), at the next login, or on arriving at or leaving a place (arrive work, leave home). A place is a name the user gave Wi-Fi networks: for "when I get to work" or "when I leave home", look it up among the user's places and use its name; one that isn't there, ask once which network it is (offer the one this computer is on now) and add it as a place first, then the reminder. An arrival or a leaving not seen in a week comes anyway. With from, an event counts only after then: "when I get to work in the morning" said in the evening is arrive work, from 05:00. It stays until dismissed, also under Do Not Disturb. It waits over a logout or a restart; one that came due meanwhile is told at the next login. For a thing to do with a date, a task is better, and for a time with others a calendar event.

when.title: When
when.description: Minutes from now (15, 90m, 1h30m; up to a week), a time of day (22:45: the next one, tomorrow's once today's has passed), wake (the first unlock after the computer next wakes from sleep), login (the next login), or arrive PLACE / leave PLACE (PLACE: the name of one of the user's places)

from.title: Not before
from.description: With an event only: it counts only after then. A time of day (05:00: the next one), minutes from now (8h) or a date and time (2026-11-23 05:00); within a week

message.title: Message
message.description: What the notification says, short. Without it: Reminder

tools.name: remind_list
tools.title: Reminders waiting
tools.description: The quick reminders still to come (remind_add's and the launcher's Tools › Remind), times soonest first, then events: {reminders: [{id, when (time, wake, login, arrive or leave), label (22:45, wake, arrive work), at (ISO 8601), at_unix, clock (HH:MM), minutes_left (these four null for an event), place (or null), from (ISO 8601, or null), state (waiting; unlock: its event came under the lock), message}]}.

tools.name: remind_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a reminder
tools.description: Takes a waiting reminder away before it's due, by its id from remind_list. Undo gives it back as it was, unless its time has passed meanwhile.
